[mozilla/uniffi-rs#2624](https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs/issues/2624).
PostingToken
The successful store purchase is going through tokenization, where the store
purchase token will be exchanged for a Proton Payment Token.
AwaitingTokenValidation
Tokenization has taken place and the Proton backend must approve the Proton
Payment Token, this happens async, therefore we await the token to be validated
The Proton Payment Token has been validated and is now chargeable. We must
notify the Proton backend of the new purchase (subscription) using this token.

PostingToken
The successful store purchase is going through tokenization, where the store
purchase token will be exchanged for a Proton Payment Token.
AwaitingTokenValidation
Tokenization has taken place and the Proton backend must approve the Proton
Payment Token, this happens async, therefore we await the token to be validated
The Proton Payment Token has been validated and is now chargeable. We must
notify the Proton backend of the new purchase (subscription) using this token.

FailedTokenState																Request conflictU
PostingToken
The successful store purchase is going through tokenization, where the store
purchase token will be exchanged for a Proton Payment Token.
AwaitingTokenValidation
Tokenization has taken place and the Proton backend must approve the Proton
Payment Token, this happens async, therefore we await the token to be validated
The Proton Payment Token has been validated and is now chargeable. We must
notify the Proton backend of the new purchase (subscription) using this token.
